newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 21.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 130.31 points or 1.62 percent to close at 7890.46 amid stiff profit taking.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index lost 2.54 points to 1,001.55, after dipping as low as 990.22.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.6360/00 a dollar at around 0020 GMT, sharply down from 2.6185/15 at its Kuala Lumpur ending on Friday.
* Currency volatility factor will continue to keep investors sidelined, with the Composite Index seen again trading below the 1,000 points, analysts said.
* U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan gives semi-annual monetary testimony to Congress on Tuesday and Wednesday, with market players watching out for clues to U.S. monetary policy.
* The stock of audio system maker Capetronic Consumer Electronics Holdings Bhd lists on the Second Board. The company offered 10.0 million shares to the public at 7.80 ringgit each.
